caName: Assistance Technique au programme d'appui à la transition énergétique, Bénin
description:
Le programme Appui à la transition énergétique au Bénin est un programme d’appui budgétaire sectoriel au profit du Gouvernement de la République du Bénin. L’objectif principal de ce programme est d’accélérer la transition énergétique au Bénin, y compris la réduction des gaz à effet de serre (GES) prévus par la Contribution déterminée au niveau national (CDN).
L’appui complémentaire à ce programme prévoit un marché de services d’assistance technique d’accompagnement afin de réaliser les objectifs spécifiques à savoir : 
•	Appuyer la mise en œuvre de la réforme sectorielle, l’opérationnalisation des dispositions réglementaires et la gouvernance sectorielle en faveur de l’accès égal à une énergie efficace, durable, 
•	Augmenter la participation du secteur privé dans le financement des investissements pour l’accès égal à l’énergie efficace, durable et moderne, la promotion de l’efficacité énergétique et de la création d’emplois, en particulier pour les jeunes et les femmes. 
•	Augmenter l’accès égal de toute la population à l’électricité, particulièrement à partir de sources renouvelables et des solutions techniques améliorées et inclusives. 
•	Augmenter l’efficacité énergétique tout au long du cycle de l’énergie (production, transport, distribution et consommation). 
Le secteur de l’énergie est au centre de cette assistance technique qui devra faciliter la mise en œuvre du programme à travers l’appui aux différents acteurs pour la réalisation de ces objectives, d’augmenter les capacités pour la mise en œuvre des politiques de réforme, d’assurer que l'évaluation et suivi des performances des politiques sectorielles sont améliorés et le dialogue politique est accompagné.

description:
The Statistical Office of Montenegro (MONSTAT) needs to implement a digital transformation of the IT system with the scope to make more data available for tackling societal, climate and environment-related challenges, contributing to healthier, more prosperous and more sustainable society. This goal will be reached by implementing two activities: 1) enabling technical services for the exchange and usage of data needed for the production of official statistics, owned by private and public sector and 2) modernizing the technology for data collection, processing and dissemination. The action is based on the priorities outlined in the Development Strategy of Official Statistics 2024-2028 and incorporate lessons from recent user satisfaction survey that note the need for using the potentials of new technologies for statistical purposes. 
MONSTAT will need to be active in developing new methods for data collection and creating new services related to data delivery for society. Considering the above, the upgrade and improvement of the collection methods and processes in official statistics, especially the delivery and dissemination of MONSTAT services, should be at the highest possible level.

description:
This project foresees implementation of activities focused on climate adaptation measures addressing both, river and torrential floods separately, taking into account their distinct characteristics and specificities, as outlined below:
River Floods
1.	Renewal of the Hydrological Information System (HIS) for the main sub-basins in Bosnia and Herzegovina, including flood events from 2010 to the present.
2.	Analysis of the impact of existing reservoirs on the water regime, with proposals for improving the management of high-water waves and enhancing water retention during dry periods.
3.	Development of guidelines for flood protection of agricultural land.
4.	Preparation of the manual “Living with Floods”, providing an overview of necessary measures and best practices for flood risk management.
Torrential Floods
1.	Development of a cadastre of torrential basins, including a sensitivity model based on existing erosion maps.

description:
Cette assistance technique s’inscrit dans le cadre de l’Action Approche Territoriale Intégrée dans le Nord de la Côte d’Ivoire (ATINORD), qui démarrera en 2026 et vise à contribuer à la stabilité de la Côte d’Ivoire via une approche territoriale intégrée dans la zone d’intervention.
Face aux nombreuses initiatives gouvernementales et internationales, les autorités ivoiriennes et les Partenaires Techniques et Financiers (PTF) qui interviennent dans les régions du Nord font le constat partagé du besoin d'une coordination renforcée entre les interventions.
Les objectifs spécifiques (réalisations) du marché seront les suivants : 
•	OS 1 – Soutenir les capacités et les outils de la Commission Nationale des Frontières en Côte d'Ivoire (CNFCI) en matière de gouvernance, de gestion, de planification, de suivi et de coordination des acteurs aux frontières 
•	OS 2 – Renforcer les capacités et les outils des autorités locales (préfectures, sous-préfectures, conseils de régions) en matière de gouvernance, de planification, de suivi et de coordination  
•	OS 3 – Mettre en œuvre la logistique pour la gouvernance et le pilotage de l’action ATINORD

description:
The Technical Assistance will work with the ECOWAS Commission to enhance their capacity for effective management of the NDICI Global Europe-funded project. A Project Management Unit in Abuja will oversee and coordinate the Transport Governance project’s activities. The Technical Assistance aims to achieve the following results:

    Harmonized implementation of inclusive and climate-resilient transport policies and regulations across Member States.
    Support for national initiatives with regional benefits, including innovative financing models such as grant-loan blending and Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs).
    Strengthened governance of road maintenance through performance-based Road Maintenance Funds and axle-load control systems.
    Enhanced efficiency of transport services along regional road corridors, supported by multimodal logistics planning and corridor observatories.
    Development of facilities and equipment tailored to local needs, integrating climate-adaptive and low-carbon principles.
    Advocacy, visibility, and mechanisms for policy dialogue platforms to ensure transparency and inclusiveness.
    Updates to policy frameworks and regional regulations, including environmental standards, climate change mitigation strategies, and gender mainstreaming in transport.
    Comprehensive activity monitoring, performance indicator establishment, steering committee organization, and annual activity reporting.

description:
The contract aims to provide support to the Ministry of Environment, Sustainable Development and Northern Region Development as the key institution, along with other relevant national stakeholders, in the preparation of high-quality infrastructure project documentation in the environmental sector, contributing to improved maturity of the Environment and Climate Change Project Pipeline. This support will be aligned with national regulations governing environmental planning and construction, as well as relevant EU standards and sectoral policies.
The project will deliver a comprehensive package of preparatory activities, including assessments of project relevance and maturity (gap assessments), preparation of technical documentation (such as feasibility studies and designs), development of tender dossiers, and support in drafting Operation Identification Sheets (OISs) and applications for major projects where applicable.
In addition to technical support, the project will provide expert advice and operational assistance to public beneficiaries and operators involved in planned investments. The Project will also assist in the development of monitoring tools to support the implementation of investment projects and contribute to enhanced coordination in the planning, preparation, implementation, and operation of investments in the environment sector.
Capacity building will be an integral part of the project, through targeted coaching, workshops, and on-the-job training, aimed at strengthening institutional capacities for project preparation and investment management.

The objective is to ensure inclusive access to digital tools for educators, contributing to improved learning outcomes and digital literacy. description:
The objective of this contract is to advance the implementation of Albania’s Digital Agenda in selected sectors by improving ICT infrastructure and aligning electronic communications policies with national and EU objectives. 

It will support the Albanian institutions, in particular the relevant Ministry and AKEP (hereinafter the beneficiaries) to increase their capabilities to promote trust in the global digital ecosystem by advancing inclusive and affordable connectivity so that all citizens can benefit from the digital economy and the future of Internet.  

In more details it will help prepare the documentations for conducting geographical survey and the methodology on very high capacity networks in the implementation of article 43 of the law no 54/2024 on electronic communication law in Albania in conformity with article 22 of EECC Directive and EU practice and drafting secondary legislation aligned with the EU regulation 2024/1309 for GIA, based on Very High-Capacity Networks (VHCN) with fibre optic and 5G. 

It will also perform the technical study for 5G use cases in smart communities based on EU best practices, design and implementation of a pilot project with 5G and awareness on gigabit infrastructure and 5G for relevant stakeholders.

description:
The European Union's engagement with partner countries has gained renewed strategic importance in response to the evolving geopolitical environment and the renewed momentum of the enlargement process. 
The programme covers partner countries at different stages of their relationship with the European Union, requiring communication approaches that reflect their respective political contexts, policy priorities and communication needs. Communication challenges differ by the fact that public awareness of the European Union's support remains uneven across the region. While the European Union is the largest donor, investor and trading partner for most partner countries, public understanding of the scale and impact of EU support, as well as of the accession process itself, remains limited. Recent perception surveys carried out under the regional communication programmes show that many citizens are insufficiently informed about the European Union's policies, financial assistance and priorities. 
Against this background, strategic communication has become an integral part of the European Union's engagement with partner countries. Previous regional communication programmes have successfully increased the visibility of the European Union, developed valuable communication tools and established networks of partners and multipliers across the region. 
The future programme will continue this effort and adopt a more strategic and service-oriented approach in supporting  DG ENEST and EU Delegations communicating the European Union's priorities across partner countries. The programme will provide communication campaigns and products, strengthen engagement with key multipliers, improve the visibility of EU support, generate communication intelligence and audience insights, and offer flexible communication services that can be mobilised in response to operational needs. This approach will ensure greater coherence across partner countries while allowing communication activities to be adapted to national contexts and emerging geopolitical developments.

description:
Le programme «CAJOU ± Compétitivité et durabilité de la filière anacarde en Côte d’Ivoire» vise à mobiliser des investissements publics et privés afin de renforcer la compétitivité, la durabilité et l’inclusivité de la filière.

Il est cofinancé par:
•	prêt de la Banque européenne d’investissement (BEI) des Nations unies.
•	contribution de l’Union européenne au titre de l’IVCDCI — PAA 2026.
•	contribution de l’UNE de l’État ivoirien à travers le Conseil du Coton, Anacarde et Karité (CCAK).

Le contractant sera chargé d’appuyer le CCAK et la Délégation de l’UE en Côte d’Ivoire, pour la mise en œuvre et le suivi des stratégies et plans d’actions nationaux dans le cadre du financement de la BEI. 

Les services en question seront mieux fournis par le prestataire de services pour les raisons suivantes (non exhaustives, éventuellement cumulatives): 


•	Le haut niveau de spécialisation requis n’est pas disponible en interne; 
•	Le besoin de flexibilité et la disponibilité nécessaire pour répondre aux besoins évolutifs et croissants. 

Le recours à des services de conseil externes est nécessaire pour répondre aux objectifs et aux besoins opérationnels de l’action et notamment i) afin d’accompagner le CCAK dans les défis en termes d’adaptation et de suivi du développement rapide de la filière; II) afin de suivre la mise en œuvre des stratégies et plans d’actions nationaux dans le cadre du financement de la BEI, iii) afin de renforcer les connaissances de l’ensemble des intervenants du secteur pour améliorer la pertinence, l’efficacité et l’inclusivité des politiques et stratégies de mise en œuvre.

description:
The subject of the contract is supply, delivery, unloading, siting and installation of the vault/cash operations equipment: machines and equipment for the protection of the euro, cash handling and gold testing. Contract is expected to contribute to the strengthening of the institutional capacities of the CBCG by ensuring smooth cash operation and continual functioning of the Vault. This assistance will support Central Bank of Montenegro to improve the operational risk and business continuity management by supplying new Vault/cash operation equipment and strengthen the institutional capacity to fulfill the requirements for alignment with EU central banking standards in the area of protection of euro against counterfeiting.
Items required: South Lift + Table + Vacuum packer, Coin sorting machine, Banknote sorting and banding machine, Desktop banknote sorting machine, Desktop coin counter, Compact scale for coins. All items are specified and described in the Annex II – Technical specifications.
For complete information about the minimum requirements, quantities, and other applicable conditions related to goods and services subject to this contract, please refer to the published tender dossier.

description:
FPI.6 is responsible for concluding centralized framework contracts (FWCs), for the coverage of needs of CFSP bodies and persons (CSDP Civilian Operations, EU Special Representatives, KSC) in a variety of supplies and services. 

In light of this, FPI.6 intends to launch an open procedure, with the aim of concluding a 4-year single framework contract, for the supply of IT hardware equipment to CFSP bodies and persons through specific contracts/orders that they will be able to place under the FWC.

The place of performance is the current places where CFSP bodies and persons are (Belgium, Ukraine, Moldova, Kosovo*, Armenia, Georgia, Iraq, Israel, occupied Palestinian territories, Somalia, Libya, Mali, Central African Republic, Ghana, Togo, Benin, Ivory Coast) and any other place worldwide where possible future CFSP bodies and persons might be established in the future.
